latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of “copywriting-master” skill:

- Provides an expert framework for persuasive copywriting and sales text in Spanish.
- Guides users through diagnosis, ideal customer profiling (FRED + PQR2), and selection of top industry frameworks (AIDA, PAS, etc).
- Delivers step-by-step structures for ads, sales emails, landing pages, and high-converting headlines.
- Includes advanced techniques for crafting hooks, bullets, handling objections, and boosting conversions using proven rules.
- Designed for any context (ads, emails, sales letters, social media) needing direct-response copy focused on actionable results.
